question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 3, 6 and 2 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to complete thrice the same work, working together?2518
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(3, 6, 2) = 6 units.

Combined efficiency = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 units/day.

Time to complete original work = 6 ÷ 6 = 1 day.

Time to complete thrice the work = 1 × 3 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**
